exposure: stage of labor at primary cesarean section (elective prelabor, unplanned first stage, unplanned second stage)
timing of primary cesarean delivery (elective vs unplanned)
cohort: 22,036 deliveries to 13,727 women with a history of one cesarean section
finding: The stage of labor at primary cesarean section did not influence the risk of placenta accreta in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women who had an unplanned cesarean section were at higher risk for placenta accreta-associated maternal complications compared to those who had an elective cesarean delivery.
